lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the CAM-433 round-1 CRITICAL finding at src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:463: the JSDoc comment on writeDispatchFailedMarkerFn had hardened the bare literal `.claude/.cam-dispatch-failed.json`, which was added by the US-004 commit (684c5a64) after US-002 certified the US-002 acceptance-criterion oracle (`! grep -rq --include='*.ts' --exclude='dispatch-failed-marker.ts' -F '.cam-dispatch-failed' src`) green. Reworded the comment to reference the filename via the exported `DISPATCH_FAILED_FILENAME` constant in prose (`.claude/${DISPATCH_FAILED_FILENAME}`) instead of the bare literal, so the literal string `.cam-dispatch-failed` no longer appears outside dispatch-failed-marker.ts. Verified the oracle passes standalone (grep exits 1 i.e. CLEAN) and re-ran the full `bun run check:all` spine (typecheck, 5663 tests, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps) all green with no ceiling raises needed. No import of DISPATCH_FAILED_FILENAME was added since it's referenced only in comment prose, not executable code (DispatchFailedMarker type was already imported). Remaining review round 1 findings still open in prd.json for future stories: US-R1-003 (revert the jsLiteral special-case encoding + rescope the oracle away from generated output), US-R1-004 (four stale 'pure function/no I/O' module-header docstrings in worker-argv.ts/plan-argv.ts/review.ts now contradict buildSpawnArgv's file I/O), US-R1-005 (verified-dispatch.ts's @cam_label uses the raw sentinel phase string, e.g. 'implementer-timeout', which isSessionStale doesn't recognize as a worker label and can cause a healthy post-timeout session to be torn down as stale on the next `cam run`).
